decisions.subject: PEP 722 inline script dependencies specification

decisions.chosen_approach: A block starts with `# /// TYPE`, ends with `# ///`, and has comment-prefixed content between delimiters containing TOML with a top-level `dependencies` field as a list of PEP 508 strings
constraints: Multiple blocks of the same type are an error

evidence.quote:
- Status: `Final`.
- Replaces: `722`.
- A block starts with `# /// TYPE`, ends with `# ///`, and has comment-prefixed content between the delimiters.
Multiple blocks of the same type are an error; unclosed blocks are ignored.
